notes.known_defects: The previously-tracked web/frontend build failure (missing i18next dependencies) is resolved: package.json lists the four i18next-family dependencies and npm run build succeeds (re-verified 2026-08-09). npm run lint currently fails once at web/frontend/src/drillPresets.js:363 because no-irregular-whitespace rejects a Japanese full-width space in a comment. Separately, tests/test_nuts_calc_init.py has 9 known-stale failures that are not a nuts_calc.py implementation defect.
notes.nuts_calc_tex_py: Experimental LaTeX renderer with zero code sharing with nuts_calc.py. It implements the seven ReportLab-compatible commands plus the LaTeX-only frac and mixed commands (nine commands total). It supports exact fractions, decimal arithmetic, mixed int/decimal/fraction expressions, and carry/borrowing constraints for two-term integer addition/subtraction. Requires pdflatex and vendors longdivision under vendor/texmf/. web/backend/renderers.py selects it with NUTS_CALC_RENDERER=latex; the frontend hides LaTeX-only cards for reportlab.
